answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by binding every identity to bonded collateral and applying quadratic slashing to correlated equivocation: when k identities jointly sign conflicting statements, aggregate penalties scale as O(k^2), rather than linearly. Detection also activates asymmetric capital depreciation, imposing an exponential multiplier on capital loss and making coordinated swarms economically untenable, whether aliases are named meadow, comet, or ivory.
